from fractions import Fraction

# Exact verification of the inequality used in the general proof.
# Coordinates in these linear expressions are (epsilon, delta, t).
def add(a, b):
    return tuple(x + y for x, y in zip(a, b))

half = Fraction(1, 2)
epsilon_half_minus_delta = (half, Fraction(-1), Fraction(0))
delta_minus_t = (Fraction(0), Fraction(1), Fraction(-1))
epsilon_minus_bound = (half, Fraction(0), Fraction(-1))

assert add(epsilon_half_minus_delta, delta_minus_t) == epsilon_minus_bound

# Forward inference using standard Euclidean theorems.
# Every rule is applied only when all of its antecedents have been established.
facts = {
    "Omega is open",
    "D is the closed ball of radius r in finite-dimensional Euclidean space",
    "D is contained in Omega",
    "r > 0",
    "verified slack identity",
}
rules = [
    (
        {
            "D is the closed ball of radius r in finite-dimensional Euclidean space",
            "r > 0",
        },
        "D is nonempty and compact",
    ),
    (
        {"Omega is open", "D is contained in Omega"},
        "each a in D has epsilon_a > 0 with B(a, epsilon_a) contained in Omega",
    ),
    (
        {
            "D is nonempty and compact",
            "each a in D has epsilon_a > 0 with B(a, epsilon_a) contained in Omega",
        },
        "finitely many B(a_i, epsilon_i/2) cover D",
    ),
    (
        {"finitely many B(a_i, epsilon_i/2) cover D"},
        "delta = min_i(epsilon_i/2) exists and is positive",
    ),
    (
        {
            "finitely many B(a_i, epsilon_i/2) cover D",
            "delta = min_i(epsilon_i/2) exists and is positive",
            "each a in D has epsilon_a > 0 with B(a, epsilon_a) contained in Omega",
            "verified slack identity",
        },
        "every point at distance less than delta from D belongs to Omega",
    ),
    (
        {
            "D is the closed ball of radius r in finite-dimensional Euclidean space",
            "r > 0",
            "delta = min_i(epsilon_i/2) exists and is positive",
        },
        "B(0, r+delta) is within distance less than delta of D",
    ),
    (
        {
            "every point at distance less than delta from D belongs to Omega",
            "B(0, r+delta) is within distance less than delta of D",
            "delta = min_i(epsilon_i/2) exists and is positive",
        },
        "R = r+delta satisfies D contained in B(0,R) contained in Omega",
    ),
]

changed = True
while changed:
    changed = False
    for antecedents, conclusion in rules:
        if antecedents <= facts and conclusion not in facts:
            facts.add(conclusion)
            changed = True

goal = "R = r+delta satisfies D contained in B(0,R) contained in Omega"
assert goal in facts

print("Expected result: YES.")
print("Choose a finite cover D ⊆ union_i B(a_i, epsilon_i/2),")
print("where B(a_i, epsilon_i) ⊆ Omega, and set delta=min_i epsilon_i/2 > 0.")
print("Then R=r+delta works.")
print("Boundary check: ||x|| <= r implies ||x|| < r+delta.")
print("For r < ||x|| < r+delta, y=r*x/||x|| lies in D")
print("and ||x-y||=||x||-r < delta, so x belongs to Omega.")
print("Submitted answer: 'R'. This neither answers yes/no nor specifies a valid R.")
print("CHECK FAIL")
